items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: The interviewee Bob Watts does not speak in the provided context. The mention of 'Blake' is made by the Interviewer in a conversational aside about a location/church, with no indication of a personal or professional relationship with the interviewee.

ctx.x: Well, I know one of the preachers.
Well, this must be up on Flake Street, eh? I don't know. You know they got a homeless church up there. Blake, that's up in Colton, eh? Well, I tell you now.
No, no, that's way down in Gentile. That's Mama Lou's church. Oh. Howard and Handy would play down there sometimes in the church.
